column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3552, B2b-2): each test runs on PostgreSQL and SQL Server and has no MySQL arm, because MySQL is single-tenant and provisioning refuses it (asserted DB-free in TestTheProvisionStatementsAreShapedPerDialect, which does not skip). test-go/support runs ./auth/... with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so the five mssql subtests skip there and the five postgres ones run. The mssql arms run, and pass, in a job that sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL.
